name: tonus-sync
author: madmax1301
description: Triggers tonus (FastAPI backend) on a schedule for automatic sync per Navidrome user. Each configured user gets LB Weekly Mirror (four 'Created For You' ListenBrainz playlists kept in sync) plus optional Genre Mixes — weekly Spotify-style playlists per genre with configurable Wed/Fri discovery+build cycle. Genre Mixes use a fixed playlist (replace pattern) so users can copy favorites into their own playlists.

scheduler.reason: Registers a recurring cron job per discovery type — the global LB-Weekly-Mirror sync (daily 07:00) plus one discovery+build pair per configured Genre Mix (Wed 02:00 / Fri 06:00 by default).

kvstore.reason: Persists last-run status (timestamps, counts, last error) per Navidrome user.

subsonicapi.reason: Creates and updates per-user LB Weekly Mirror playlists and Genre Mix playlists in Navidrome on behalf of each configured user.

users.reason: LB Weekly Mirror + playlist creation runs in the context of each selected Navidrome user.

taskqueue.reason: One async task per Navidrome user runs the trigger + reconcile pipeline outside the cron callback timeout.

tonus_url.title: tonus URL
tonus_url.description: Base URL of the tonus backend. Example: http://tonus.lan:8000 (no trailing slash).

tonus_token.title: API Token
tonus_token.description: Bearer token from tonus's TONUS_API_TOKEN env var. Leave empty if tonus runs without a token.

cron_expression.title: Cron Expression
cron_expression.description: When to run the sync for all configured users. Default: '0 7 * * *' (daily at 07:00). Use crontab.guru to test custom values.

users.title: User Mappings
users.description: Each entry maps a Navidrome user to a ListenBrainz account. Use the + button to add additional users.

navidrome_username.title: Navidrome Username
navidrome_username.description: Must match an existing user that this plugin has access to (see Users Permission).

listenbrainz_username.title: ListenBrainz Username
listenbrainz_username.description: Public LB user whose 'Created For You' playlists are mirrored for this Navidrome user.

lb_weekly_mirror.title: LB Weekly Mirror
lb_weekly_mirror.description: Spiegelt die vier ListenBrainz 'Created For You'-Playlists (Weekly/Last Week's Exploration + Jams) als Navidrome-Playlists dieses Users und hält sie aktuell.

mixes.title: Genre Mixes
mixes.description: Optional: Spotify-style weekly playlists per genre. Each mix has its own discovery cron (Wed 02:00 default, fills the download queue) + build cron (Fri 06:00 default, builds the Navidrome playlist). Build replaces the playlist content — favorites/custom playlists you've made elsewhere are unaffected.

name.title: Mix Name
name.description: Display name. Used as playlist title via the template below. Examples: 'Metalcore Weekly', 'Hip-Hop Discovery'.

genre.title: Genre
genre.description: ListenBrainz genre tag. Cluster-sorted: Rock → Punk → Shoegaze → Metal → Hip-Hop → Electronic → Synth/Lo-Fi → Pop → Regional Pop → R&B → Folk → Jazz → Classical → World/Latin → Experimental.

discovery_cron.title: Discovery Cron
discovery_cron.description: When to fetch new tracks for this mix and queue missing ones for download. Default: Wednesday 02:00 — gives the queue 48h before the build cron picks them up.

build_cron.title: Build Cron
build_cron.description: When to build the Subsonic playlist from the discovered (and meanwhile downloaded) tracks. Default: Friday 06:00.

count.title: Tracks per Mix
count.description: How many tracks the final playlist should contain. Discovery may fetch more candidates internally before deduping against the library.

discovery_ratio.title: Discovery Ratio
discovery_ratio.description: 0.0 = all familiar (your library), 1.0 = all new discoveries. Default 0.4 = 40% new / 60% familiar — Spotify-style mix.

playlist_template.title: Playlist Name Template
playlist_template.description: Subsonic playlist name. Placeholders: {name} → mix name, {genre} → genre tag, {user} → Navidrome username, {date} → YYYY-MM-DD (only used on first build, kept after that since playlist is replaced in-place).
